name: Herodias
title: The Vengeful Queen
summary: Herodias was the granddaughter of Herod the Great and was first married to her uncle, Herod Philip. She left him to marry his half-brother, Herod Antipas, which led John the Baptist to publicly criticize this forbidden marriage. Her hatred for John culminated in his execution.

keyEvents.title: Illegal Marriage with Herod Antipas
keyEvents.description: Herodias left her husband, Herod Philip, to marry his half-brother, Herod Antipas, which was forbidden according to Jewish law.

keyEvents.title: John's Condemnation of the Marriage
keyEvents.description: John the Baptist publicly criticized the illegal marriage and told Herod that it was not lawful for him to have his brother's wife.

keyEvents.title: Herodias' Hatred for John
keyEvents.description: Herodias bore a grudge against John and wanted to kill him, but Herodes protected the prophet because he feared the people and knew that John was a righteous man.

keyEvents.title: Planning John's Death
keyEvents.description: When Salome danced for Herodes on his birthday and received a promise, Herodias instructed her daughter to ask for John's head on a platter.

keyEvents.title: John is Beheaded
keyEvents.description: Herodes, bound by his oath before the guests, ordered that John be beheaded in prison. The head was brought to Salome, who gave it to her mother.
